skillFull: Moves forward at certain intervals, gathering energy before slicing forward using the built-up energy and creating Agar Jellies. Level Up for more points for Agar Jellies.
story:
A little piece of agar agar that followed Icon Agar Agar Cookie out of the well into a much bigger world. With nothing to rely upon except the very Cookie it followed after, it has even gone as far to mimic Agar Agar Cookie as she mimics Icon Pomegranate Cookie!

Its mimicry can be a bit bland compared to Agar Agar Cookie, and as the Cookie completes incredible feats that bend nature to her will, the little Pet does no more than pop out small Agar Jellies. However, these Jellies hold the Pet's most sincere wishes to soothe Agar Agar Cookie's unquenchable hunger.

Since it's the thought that counts, these Jellies should at least fill up the Cookie's heart!

combi.desc: +24,000,000 pts for Mimicked Elemental Power Points

costumes.name: Acolyte of Despair
costumes.info: As an acolyte, Agarlotl does everything in its power to serve the Harbinger of the Depths. When the Cookie places sins and anguish upon the alter, over time a soft, squishy presence makes them all fade away without a trace. Do not let your guard down simply because your wrongdoings have disappeared, though, for your karma will be waiting there, unseen, for the day you fall into darkness.
